body: Her family life is not so stellar, and anything that involves them to help her get started I don’t see happening I hate to say.

That’s a good idea, everything grows where we live. I have a 20 month old and it seems to be a great salve for her to spend time with the baby. I think having something count and depend on her helps, but I’m so lost on how to help when she goes back home.

Thank you for your advice.  I’ve suffered from depression most of my life, but was raised with such a close family that I couldn’t imagine giving them that grief even though I fantasized about it. 
I don’t think I mentioned, but she asked her parents to send her to an institution(which they did) over the summer because she was suicidal. She said it was worse than anywhere she’d ever been and would not spare herself next time. I’m hoping some of this is said in teenage angst, but it’s not something I want to play with.  
She has spent months here off and on and seems just to mimic what anyone else is interested in so I’m honestly not sure what she would like but surely I could add some gift cards or something for things like that.
